steps.title: Create PubMLST account
steps.instruction: Sign up for a free PubMLST account (takes about one minute) to enable data upload, bookmarking, and access to all public data.

steps.title: Open isolate database and switch view
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Neisseria isolate database on PubMLST; click the purple tab at the top right to change the dashboard to a simple index view.

steps.title: Expand search form and enable tooltips
steps.instruction: On the isolate search page, click the dark purple "modify form" tab (spanner icon) at the top right to expand the limited search form, then click the "tooltips" tab to enable tooltips.

steps.title: Define species filter and additional fields
steps.instruction: In the expanded form, under "isolate provenance/primary metadata fields" select "species" and type "Neisseria gonorrhoeae"; use the + icon next to this field to add extra filters such as year or continent.

steps.title: Enter isolate identifiers (optional)
steps.instruction: If you have a list of specific isolates, paste their IDs or names into the "attribute values" box; you may also use the "isolate" field with "CONTAINS" to search by common name patterns.

steps.title: Search the database
steps.instruction: Click the + symbol next to the search button on the right hand side of the screen and choose "search database" to run the query.

steps.title: Apply allele or LIN code filters (optional)
steps.instruction: To filter by sequence type, use the "allele designations/scheme fields" box; select LIN code (N. gonorrhoeae cgMLST v2) from the drop‑down, set the middle box to "starts with", and type the LIN code prefix of interest.

steps.title: Run analysis tools
steps.instruction: After results load, use the "Breakdown" buttons—"Fields", "Two Fields", or "Combinations"—to create tables/figures; click "Sequence bin" to export contig statistics (contig number, GC %, total length); use "Genome Comparator" for alignments and distance matrices; optionally run "rMLST species id" for species assignment.

steps.title: Export data
steps.instruction: Click "Export dataset" to download a spreadsheet containing isolate metadata, allele assignments, STs, and LIN codes; use "Export Contigs" to download assembled contigs or "Export Sequences" for specific gene sequences.

steps.title: Upload your own data (optional)
steps.instruction: To add private data, click the "submissions" button on the right hand side, or use the "private data" button to keep the dataset hidden until publication.

steps.title: Save dataset for future use
steps.instruction: Bookmark the current query or add it to a project via the bookmarking/project options (available after logging in) for quick future access.
